import sqlite3
import uuid
import datetime
from typing import Optional, List

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from pydantic import BaseModel
from passlib.context import CryptContext
from jose import JWTError, jwt

# Configuration
SECRET_KEY = "supersecretkey123"  # In production, use env variable
ALGORITHM = "HS256"
TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60

# Database setup
DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3"

def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        yield conn
    finally:
        conn.close()

def init_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            hashed_password TEXT NOT NULL
        )
    """)
    cursor.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS diary_entries (
            entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            text TEXT NOT NULL,
            photo TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

# Password hashing
pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto")

# JWT security
security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)

# Pydantic models
class EntryCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    text: str
    photo: Optional[str] = None

class EntryIDResponse(BaseModel):
    entry_id: str

class Entry(BaseModel):
    entry_id: str
    title: str
    text: str
    photo: Optional[str] = None

class UserRegister(BaseModel):
    username: str
    password: str

class UserLogin(BaseModel):
    username: str
    password: str

class Token(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str = "bearer"

# Helper to create token
def create_access_token(data: dict):
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(minutes=TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    encoded_jwt = jwt.encode(to_encode, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)
    return encoded_jwt

# Dependency to get current user
def get_current_user(credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security),
                     db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    if credentials is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Not authenticated")
    token = credentials.credentials
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        user_id: int = payload.get("user_id")
        if user_id is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid token")
    except JWTError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid token")
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
    user = cursor.fetchone()
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="User not found")
    return dict(user)

# Initialize FastAPI app
app = FastAPI(title="DiaryEntryWithPhotoStorage", version="1.0.0")

@app.on_event("startup")
def startup():
    init_db()

# User registration endpoint
@app.post("/register", response_model=Token)
def register(user: UserRegister, db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    cursor = db.cursor()
    # Check if user exists
    cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?", (user.username,))
    if cursor.fetchone():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Username already exists")
    hashed = pwd_context.hash(user.password)
    cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (username, hashed_password) VALUES (?, ?)", (user.username, hashed))
    db.commit()
    user_id = cursor.lastrowid
    # Create token
    token = create_access_token(data={"user_id": user_id, "sub": user.username})
    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer"}

# User login endpoint
@app.post("/login", response_model=Token)
def login(user: UserLogin, db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT id, username, hashed_password FROM users WHERE username = ?", (user.username,))
    db_user = cursor.fetchone()
    if not db_user or not pwd_context.verify(user.password, db_user["hashed_password"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid credentials")
    token = create_access_token(data={"user_id": db_user["id"], "sub": user.username})
    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer"}

# POST /entries
@app.post("/entries", response_model=EntryIDResponse, status_code=201)
def create_entry(entry: EntryCreate, current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    entry_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute(
        "INSERT INTO diary_entries (entry_id, user_id, title, text, photo) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (entry_id, current_user["id"], entry.title, entry.text, entry.photo)
    )
    db.commit()
    return {"entry_id": entry_id}

# GET /entries
@app.get("/entries", response_model=List[Entry])
def get_entries(current_user: dict = Depends(get_current_user), db: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):
    cursor = db.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT entry_id, title, text, photo FROM diary_entries WHERE user_id = ?", (current_user["id"],))
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    entries = []
    for row in rows:
        entries.append({
            "entry_id": row["entry_id"],
            "title": row["title"],
            "text": row["text"],
            "photo": row["photo"]  # could be None
        })
    return entries

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
